# A known cycle is a complete blocked result, alongside independently ready work.
exec ctx orient --project bundle
! stderr .
stdout 'Evaluation: complete; inventory: complete'
stdout 'dependency_cycle'
stdout 'Dependency edges:'
stdout 'status: fail; cycle: true'
stdout 'A \[a\]'
stdout 'B \[b\]'
stdout 'readiness: blocked; eligible: false'
stdout 'readiness: ready; eligible: true'

exec ctx orient --project bundle --json
! stderr .
cp stdout report.json
jsonorientation report.json true
stdout '"cycle":true'
stdout '"code":"dependency_cycle"'
stdout '"shortlist":\[\{[^}]*"id":"ready"[^}]*\}\]'

# The same cycle can have complete task context, with its established warning.
exec ctx context --project bundle --ticket a.md
! stderr .
cp stdout context.json
jsonresult context.json true true
stdout 'dependency_cycle'

# A missing target makes affected work unknown while independent work stays eligible.
rm bundle/b.md
exit 1 ctx orient --project bundle
! stderr .
stdout 'Evaluation: partial; inventory: complete'
stdout 'source_missing'
stdout 'status: unknown; cycle: false'
stdout 'readiness: unknown; eligible: false'
stdout 'readiness: ready; eligible: true'
exit 1 ctx orient --project bundle --json
! stderr .
cp stdout partial.json
jsonorientation partial.json false
stdout '"code":"source_missing"'
stdout '"shortlist":\[\{[^}]*"id":"ready"[^}]*\}\]'

-- bundle/project.md --
---
type: Project
id: project
title: Cyclic dependencies
---
## Goals
Explain known cycles and preserve independent work.
## Current commitments
- [A](a.md)
- [Ready](ready.md)
## Open decisions
None

---
type: WorkItem

triage: ready-for-agent

---

- [ ] Deliver A.
## Blocked by
- [B](b.md)
## Blocked by decisions
None

- [ ] Deliver B.

- [A](a.md)

None
